memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: Reports good energy, manages hotel duties, walks 30 minutes daily; no difficulty with ADLs.
cognition: Mini-Cog score 3/5 (negative); recalls hotel routines well.
falls: No falls in past 12 months; gait steady; timed up-and-go 9 seconds (normal).
medicines: 6 regular (metformin, glimepiride, sitagliptin, empagliflozin, melatonin, trazodone); polypharmacy – review against Beers criteria advised.
mood: Denies low mood or anxiety; PHQ-2 score 0.
carers: Wife Priya, spouse.
goals: "I want to sleep better and keep my sugar under control."
